entries.07eb6415f807e767: Companies and organizations that conduct SNS marketing
entries.1c65b0cc74d198ce: This business, centered on investment management in the Web3 field, is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries Nonagon Capital LLC and NONAGON CAPITAL PTE.LTD. In addition to investing mainly in Web3-related startups in the United States, it provides the corporate report and community services "Nonagon Report" and "Nonagon Connect," and conducts a validator operation support service launched in the fiscal year ended December 2025 as well as DeFi operations. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥9 million.
entries.277b0b9621d78b22: This business segment mainly sells access rights to various SNS data through its US subsidiary, Effyis, Inc. Revenue was ¥1,315 million, down 32.6% from the previous year, due to the termination of contracts with some data providers and the review of client contracts following changes in the North American market.
entries.4f687332cbe8217d: This business segment provides SNS marketing support mainly for the Japanese domestic market. Its main services are SNS advertising, SNS operation consulting and the provision of SNS analysis tools. Revenue was ¥2,325 million, up 0.5% from the previous year.
entries.7a5b78a66037a647: Companies interested in the Web3 field
entries.898c4c0a69bf0610: A company that collects and analyzes social big data, and carries out SNS marketing support for companies and investment management in the Web3 area.
entries.d492d9acffb683b4: Domestic listed companies aiming to enter validator operations
entries.ea9656167144b9e6: A business that collects, analyzes and utilizes social big data to contribute to the activities of companies and organizations. It is carried out by the company and its consolidated subsidiary, Effyis, Inc., and consists of 2 business categories: SNS marketing support and DaaS. The bases of this business are the head office in Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, and Effyis, Inc. in Michigan, United States. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,641 million.
